counterfactuals.justification: Scaling a row does not depend on entries in other rows, by tutorial 3150’s definition.

limitations: No finite audit proves absence of every incidental shortcut.
Captured inventory basis 5359 contains only twelve original questions; none is relabeled as generated. Live later inventory can differ.
No live learner history, policy weights, task IDs or future generated entity IDs were supplied. Selection tests use actual rules on explicit provisional pools and report conditional conclusions.
q-20240 and q-20389 lack captured keys, worked solutions and ratings; canonical e-4695 lacks an answer field. Those missing artifacts are not invented or certified.
